text:
Elena: Heads-up: I'm assembling the release notes for Friday's docs deploy. Top items: embeddings migration snippet update, a broken internal anchor from the migration guide, and a one-line SDK rename (jsClient -> client). Need owners for snippet, redirect, and final relnotes wording.

Raj: I can pick up the snippet. Failing example in integration tests: `await jsClient.embed('sample')` -> 400 "bad request". Doc replacement to recommend: `await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'rwd-embed-1', input: 'sample' })`. I'll include both JS and Python minimal examples.

Omar: I'll do the redirect. CI LinkCheck found guides/migration/embedding.md#legacy pointing to a moved anchor at migration/embedding-v2.md#legacy-embeddings. I'll add a _redirects.yaml entry and update the internal link.

Yuki: For relnotes copy, keep it short: one user-facing bullet + migration pointer. Draft: "Embeddings: SDK request shape updated. Update client code to use client.embeddings.create() — see Embeddings migration guide for examples and a quick diff." Thoughts?

Raj: Yeah keep relnotes concise. I'll put the full diff in the migration guide and only the final example in relnotes.

docs-bot: Link Scanner: 1 broken anchor detected -> guides/migration/embedding.md#legacy (resolved by proposed redirect).

Elena: Plan: Raj opens snippet PR with examples and a changelog line; Omar opens redirect PR and flags infra for quick merge; Yuki will draft relnotes and post for signoff once PRs are linked. Aim to merge before Thursday 10:00 UTC so redirects are in Friday deploy.

Raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2133. Includes minimal JS + Python snippets and a short entry for the changelog examples section.

Omar: Redirect PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2134. Added _redirects.yaml entry mapping the old anchor to the new path. Tagging infra for expedited review.

Yuki: Draft relnotes posted in the draft PR comments. Copy: "Embeddings API: method signatures changed — update SDK usage. See Embeddings migration guide for migration steps and code examples. Known issue: pre-0.9 SDKs may get 4xx errors when calling old embed methods."

Elena: Quick checklist before final publish:
- Raj: ensure snippet PR includes one-line diff in migration guide (assigned)
- Omar: get redirect merged and confirm with infra (assigned)
- Yuki: finalize relnotes and ping #docs for signoff (assigned)

Raj: I'll add the diff and also run `make linkcheck` locally before requesting merge.

Omar: Noted. I'll follow up with infra and watch CI for redirects.

Elena: Thanks all. If you see other broken anchors run `./scripts/link-scanner` and mention them here. Will post final relnotes once both PRs are merged. :thumbsup:
